content:
The tallest building in the world is the **Burj Khalifa** in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It stands at a height of 828 meters (2,717 feet) and has held this record since its completion in 2010.

The building has 163 floors above ground and was designed by Adrian Smith of Skidmore, Owings and Merrill. It's a mixed-use skyscraper containing offices, residential apartments, hotel accommodations, and observation decks.
